headline: Poland's prime minister warns of Russian 'accidental' attacks on Ukraine's allies
context: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said that these potential strikes "intend to paralyze NATO" in an attempt to demonstrate that Article 5 "exists only in theory."
